title: vepris glandulosa
intro: Vepris glandulosa, commonly known as African Greenheart, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is known for its traditional use in African medicine and is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Vepris glandulosa include pain relief, wound healing, and fever reduction, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as limonoids and flavonoids. Research has shown that the bioactive compounds present in Vepris glandulosa, including alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, exhibit a range of pharmacological activities that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
